answer: Per-identity hardware activation fee requires every action to carry a secure-element signature over a fresh nonce, logged once on the lagoon ledger. Duplicate or replayed keys are rejected, and each new key must clear a revocation check seeded by cedar before it can earn. The attacker pays $1.25 plus 0.02 kWh metered compute per key. A hollow recovery delay adds 48 hours before payout, so each marginal clone’s expected return stays strictly below zero.
